name: Desert Journey Of Israel Through The
overview: The desert journey of Israel through the wilderness is marked by God's faithful guidance and deliverance, as He calls Moses to lead His people out of Egypt with the assurance of His presence (Exodus 3:10-12). This journey includes miraculous interventions such as the crossing of the Red Sea, where God decisively defeats the pursuing Egyptians by hindering their chariots and causing them to flee in fear, demonstrating that the LORD fights for Israel (Exodus 14:23-25). These events underscore God's sovereign protection and the call for Israel to serve Him in obedience on the promised mountain.
